name: loc
description: Library of Congress (loc.gov): read the homepage's featured stories, trending content, top searches and gallery highlights, and fetch WebVTT captions for LOC webcast videos.

commands.name: list-featured-stories
commands.summary: List the featured stories in the rotating banner on the Library of Congress homepage (title, description, link).

commands.name: list-trending
commands.summary: List trending items on the homepage (blog posts, magazine articles, videos), with their format (Blog, Magazine, Watch) and link.

commands.name: list-top-searches
commands.summary: List the 'Top Searches' terms shown on the homepage, with their loc.gov search URLs.

commands.name: list-gallery-highlights
commands.summary: List the captioned collection photos in the homepage masonry gallery.

commands.name: get-webcast-captions
commands.summary: Fetch the WebVTT caption/transcript track for a Library of Congress webcast video served from tile.loc.gov.

params.name: media_id
params.description: IIIF media identifier of the webcast rendition. Colon-separated, e.g. media:webcasts:<year>:<id>:<id>-<WxH>_<bitrate>. It appears in the video URLs on loc.gov pages.

params.name: track
params.description: Caption track index (0 = first or default track).

notes: The explorer could not use keyword search. /search/ was blocked by robots/client rules, and /photos/?q= and /collections/ returned a 307 to a Cloudflare bot-verification page. That is why there are no search commands. If loc.gov stops challenging automated clients, its public JSON API (append fo=json to /search/, /photos/ or /collections/ URLs) would be the right basis for search commands.
The URLs returned by list-top-searches point to /search/?q=..., which may hit the same block.
Homepage content (featured stories, trending items, gallery) rotates over time, so results change.
get-webcast-captions returns raw WebVTT text: timestamps, speaker labels such as '>> Name:' and caption lines. The media_id contains colons and must be passed verbatim.
